title: Bhalliya

  • Ekakanipāta The Book of the Ones
  • Paṭhamavagga Chapter One

Bhalliyattheragāthā Bhalliya

“Yopānudī maccurājassa senaṁ, He has cast aside the army of the King of Death, Naḷasetuṁva sudubbalaṁ mahogho; as a fragile bridge of reeds by a great flood. Vijitāvī apetabheravo hi, Victorious since his fears have vanished: Danto so parinibbuto ṭhitatto”ti. tame and steadfast, he has become quenched.

Itthaṁ sudaṁ āyasmā bhalliyo thero gāthaṁ abhāsitthāti. That is how this verse was recited by the senior venerable Bhalliya.
